project_overview: 警察案件跟踪系统，用于警务人员记录、调查和起诉案件，并提供案件搜索功能

functions.name: ProsecuteCase
acceptance_criteria: 能够记录与法庭的所有交互
能够跟踪案件起诉进度

functions.name: SearchCase
acceptance_criteria: 能够按人员、犯罪类型、作案手法、财产等搜索
能够按案件或嫌疑人/被告自定义结果视图
能够执行月报、RTI相关等查询
functions.preconditions: 用户必须具有案件访问权限

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内执行简单搜索
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在10-15秒内执行高级搜索
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to perform a simple search within 5-8 seconds and a advanced search (multiple search criteria) within 10-15 seconds regardless of the storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在5-8秒内检索并显示最近2个月内访问过的案件
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 5-8 seconds the case which has been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

constraints.description: 系统必须能够在20秒内检索并显示最近2个月内未访问过的案件
constraints.source_text: The System must be able to retrieve and display within 20 seconds the case which has not been accessed within the previous 2 months, regardless of storage capacity or number of cases in the system.

exceptions.description: 用户尝试访问无权限的案件
exceptions.trigger: 用户请求访问或搜索无权访问的案件
exceptions.handling: 根据配置提供不同级别的响应：显示标题和元数据/仅显示案件存在/不显示任何信息

non_functional_requirements.description: 系统必须提供足够的响应时间，在标准和高负载条件下都能满足常用功能的性能需求
系统用户界面必须适合有特殊需求的用户使用
系统必须记录用户尝试访问无权限案件的行为
